ALTER TABLE student_learning_session
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS selected_explanation_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (selected_explanation_count >= 0),
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS code_run_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (code_run_count >= 0),
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (failure_count >= 0),
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS passed_test_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (passed_test_count >= 0),
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stuck_signal_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stuck_signal_count >= 0);
